system.description:
• The continent-wide network originating from Opal, working closely with Opal's government. Many members worship Mask. The Owl runs everything through Ravens; Crows carry out the high-value work. The Guild deals in assassination but is equally an information empire — knowing who to kill and why is half the job.
  • Sanctioned Strike: increase the DC of the target's Death Attack save by 1 when the contract was formally issued through Guild channels — the preparation time and intelligence support raises the quality of the strike.
  • Dossier: Advantage on Case Target checks when the target's dossier has been provided by a Raven or Crow superior. Recognised on sight by other Guild members as a Crow.
